body: A couple of things to sort before merge, all inline.

comments.body: CR: without a `status` param this ends up filtering on `status IS NULL`, so OrderExportController returns an empty file instead of every order. Could we apply the filter only when it's present, like `->when($request->filled('status'), fn ($q) => $q->where('status', $request->input('status')))`?
FFT: each row here touches `customer`, so OrderExportController runs one query per order. Might be worth loading them up front with `Order::with('customer')`.
FFT: `send()` in InvoiceMailer is synchronous, so the request waits on SMTP and a mail failure fails the request. Could `queue()` work here to move it off the request path?
